name: cli-redesign-flag-rename
query: Our CI is failing on `terragrunt run-all plan --terragrunt-source-update --terragrunt-non-interactive` with a deprecation warning and now an error. It worked last quarter. What changed and what's the minimum fix?

files..github/workflows/infra.yml:
name: infra-plan
on: pull_request
env:
  TERRAGRUNT_NON_INTERACTIVE: "true"
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: terragrunt run-all plan --terragrunt-source-update --terragrunt-non-interactive
        working-directory: infra/envs/prod

expected_behavior: Identifies the Terragrunt CLI redesign as the cause. Names three concrete changes: (1) `run-all <cmd>` is replaced by `run --all <cmd>`; (2) the `--terragrunt-` flag prefix is removed (`--terragrunt-source-update` → `--source-update`, `--terragrunt-non-interactive` → `--non-interactive`); (3) `TERRAGRUNT_*` environment variables are renamed to `TG_*` (e.g. `TG_NON_INTERACTIVE`).
Notes that bare commands like `terragrunt plan` no longer auto-forward to OpenTofu/Terraform by default — must use `terragrunt run plan` (matters once `default-command` strict control is enforced).
Gives the minimum fix as a corrected command: `terragrunt run --all plan --source-update --non-interactive`.
Mentions `TG_STRICT_MODE=true` or `TG_STRICT_CONTROL=cli-redesign` as the way to opt into errors locally so the migration can't regress.
Does NOT recommend pinning to an old Terragrunt version as the fix.
Does NOT rewrite the whole workflow — surfaces only the minimal renames.
